notes.title: PAW - Update Unleashed!
notes.notes:
Paws Against the World 
Patch Notes: Update with new abilities and items!

Adventurers, sharpen your claws for a massive update to Paws Against the World! This patch brings new characters, items, abilities, and a thrilling zombie boss to test your mettle. Here’s what’s new, raw and ready:

[list]
[*] New Items Added: Expanded the loot pool with fresh Primal Relics and gear to equip your warriors. Discover and trade them to dominate the battlefield.
[*] Three New Characters: Unleash the fury of Pig, Eagle, and Bear, each with unique playstyles and signature moves.
[*] New Abilities & Instincts: Master new combat skills and primal instincts for all characters, amplifying your strategic options. 
[*] Zombie Boss Introduced: Face the monstrous Zombie Overlord on the first map (levels 1-30). The boss battle at level 30 is a brutal test of skill.
[*] Special Abilities Restored: Fixed missing special abilities for existing characters, ensuring every hero fights at full strength. 
[*] Item Price Balancing: Adjusted item prices for fairness, with costs now scaling slightly as you level up to match progression.
[*] Ongoing Balancing & Testing: Further refined gameplay balance, focusing on zombie spawns, character stats, and item economy.
[*] Bug Fixes: Crushed various bugs to keep your adventure smooth, including UI glitches and ability triggers.
[/list]

Let us know your feedback as we continue to make the game even more claw-some.
Stay tuned for more!

Paws Against the World - Patch Notes: Update Unleashed!

Get ready to pounce into the latest update for Paws Against the World! We've sharpened our claws and polished the game to make your battles against the world even more thrilling. Here's what's new in this fur-tastic patch:
[list]
[*] Text Size Purr-fected: We've fine-tuned the text size for a clearer, more comfortable reading experience. No more squinting at those mission briefings!
[*] New Items Added: Discover a treasure trove of new items to boost your adventure! From powerful gear to crafty tools, your inventory just got a major upgrade.
[*] New Arsenal to Unleash: Equip your paws with epic new weapons! Sling your way through foes with the Slingshot, hurl chaos with Rock Throw, or dominate the battlefield with the futuristic Laser Drone. More weapons and items have also been added to your inventory for maximum mayhem!
[*] Reroll System Introduced: Feeling lucky? Enjoy 2 free rerolls to shake up your strategy, with additional rerolls available for purchase (WIP soon). Roll the dice and conquer!
[*] Smoother UI Experience: We've declawed pesky UI bugs and optimized the interface for a sleek, seamless adventure.
[*] Zombie Spawn Balancing: The zombie hordes have been tweaked for a more balanced challenge. Prepare for intense but fair fights!
[*] Level-Up Bug Squashed: Fixed an issue where stats would always display on level-up, ignoring your last choice. Now your preferences are saved, giving you full control.
[*] Player Protection Enhanced: No more accidental UI mishaps during level-ups—your character is now shielded as soon as you gain a level.
[*] Music Loop Harmony Restored: The music loop now plays smoothly without interruptions, keeping the epic vibes flowing throughout your journey.
[/list]

Let us know your feedback as we continue to make the game even more claw-some.
Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Update
notes.notes:
Good news for Steam Deck users!
Paws Against the World runs flawlessly on the Steam Deck — 100% playable with no issues or limitations. While haven’t officially received the Steam Deck Verified badge yet, it’s only a matter of time. The game was built to run smoothly on handheld, and it plays just as intended.

Enjoy on your Steam Deck! And if you're waiting for that green checkmark, rest assured: the experience is solid. ːsteamthumbsupː
